page.layout: One page of text; headings at full width at top; main text in one column with page-date notes ("A. C.", numbers) in the right margin; running head and signature at foot. Faint show-through of the reverse page at top is ignored.

main_text.l: Quo res in historia Ecclesiae Romanae narratae,
Junias, insignes inter Apostolos, Saulis persecu-
toris cognati, & ante ipsum ad Christum conversi,
Romam perrexisse, atque ibi Christum praedicâsse
videntur, Rom. xvi. 7. Paulo mox eorum, vel
suum, Romanos Christo lucrifaciente, & in agni-
ta veritate confirmante. ib. v. 25. §. II.
Paulus Romanis fidem in toto orbe celebrem gratulatur. §. III.
S. Ignatius Romanam Ecclesiam insignibus elogiis mactat. §. IV.
POst Apostolorum tempora Ecclesia virgo casta esse definit. §.

page.notes: Marginal note "A. C." is a heading for the date column, with the dates 34, 60, 91, 101 beside the lines. The large woodcut initial "E" is joined to "Ecclesiâ". The reference "§. I. — VI." and similar are section ranges. Some letters in the top running title area are faint show-through and were not transcribed.
